notes.title: Maze Roller 1.1 Update
notes.content:
Hi Everyone,

We posted the Maze Roller 1.1 update earlier today!  This update includes an updated game engine that provides VR enhancements and optimizations.  In addition, it also fixes some issues reported by users using the Xbox One controller.  Happy Maze Rolling!

The Meerkat Gaming Team

notes.title: Game Giveaway!
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/x9y23Em.jpg[/img]

The full version of Maze Roller is releasing on August 23rd and we're giving away 25 free copies on launch day. The rules are simple:

[list]
[*]Step 1: Download the free Maze Roller demo on Steam
[*]Step 2: Play the demo between 8/8/16 - 8/22/16 and earn the "Cheese Wiz" title on all 3 game modes (triple cheese score)
[*]Step 3: Submit the [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeXQ9mlZOEzCp6SrxVV5PDBj7W5lzg4UMm3g1kOu9Q2v904xA/viewform]entry form[/url] at http://mazeroller.com/giveaway
[/list]

On August 23rd, we'll randomly select 25 eligible entries and send them a Steam key to unlock the full version of the game.

notes.title: Small Demo Hotfix
notes.content:
Hi Everyone!

We hope you're enjoying the Maze Roller Demo.  We just uploaded a small patch to fix 2 small issues.

- Pinwheel level not ending properly when you reach your cheese
- Redundant help text for motion controls when resetting camera view

Don't be shy in giving us feedback on the discussion boards and let us know if you encounter any other bugs.

Happy rolling!
